headline: Aguascalientes consolidates as a benchmark for sustainable automotive production
summary: Nissan Mexicana has reached four million vehicles assembled using sustainable processes in Aguascalientes. More than 95% of the electricity used in its manufacturing operations comes from carbon-free sources.
why: Nissan Mexicana is the Mexican manufacturing arm of Nissan Motor, a Japanese automaker with significant production in Mexico.
original_headline: Aguascalientes se consolida como referente de producción automotriz sustentable
